ov: Kenwood TM-D750A Tri-Band Digital Mobile Transceivers Kenwood TM-D750A Tri-Band Digital Mobile Transceivers set a new standard for Amateur Radio operators seeking advanced digital communications, integrated navigation capabilities, and exceptional ease of use in a modern tri-band mobile transceiver. Covering the 2 meter (144-148 MHz), 1.25 meter (222-225 MHz), and 70 centimeter (420-450 MHz) amateur bands, the TM-D750A combines powerful RF performance with a feature-rich operating platform designed for voice, data, APRS®, and D-STAR® communications.At the heart of the TM-D750A is a bright, high-resolution 3.45-inch TFT color LCD that delivers exceptional clarity, vibrant color, and wide viewing angles. Enhancing situational awareness, the radio features Visual Scan with Waterfall, displaying scan history and signal activity in a vivid, easy-to-interpret waterfall format that helps operators quickly identify active frequencies and band conditions. Multiple dedicated knobs and push buttons provide fast, intuitive access to key functions, making it easy to navigate menus, adjust settings, and manage communications whether operating from a vehicle, base station, or the field.Built with connectivity in mind, the TM-D750A features integrated Bluetooth®, Wireless LAN, GPS, and APRS functionality, enabling seamless communication across multiple platforms. Its built-in APRS-compliant TNC supports real-time two-way data communications, making it ideal for position reporting, tactical messaging, event coordination, and emergency communications. The integrated GPS receiver and patch antenna provide accurate location information without the need for external accessories, while the built-in KISS TNC supports packet communications at 1200 and 9600 bps, standalone digipeater operation, and IGate applications when connected to a computer.For operators utilizing digital voice technology, the TM-D750A offers extensive D-STAR® compatibility and network connectivity options. Integrated Wireless LAN allows direct access to D-STAR networks through Direct Mode without requiring additional hardware. The transceiver also supports Reflector Terminal Mode, enabling convenient access to D-STAR reflectors through a Windows® PC or Android™ device using either a USB or Bluetooth connection. With simultaneous reception capability, operators can monitor and receive both voice and data communications at the same time, expanding operational awareness and communication flexibility.The transceiver's thoughtfully engineered layout includes a remote control head with a built-in speaker, offering versatile installation options without sacrificing audio performance. Renowned Kenwood audio quality ensures crisp, natural-sounding receive audio, while a comprehensive voice guidance system featuring more than 900 voice phrases and four selectable speech speeds enhances accessibility and operating convenience.Modern connectivity is further enhanced with USB-C ports for straightforward programming, firmware updates, and data communications. ov: Kenwood TH-D75A Tri-Band 144/220/430 MHz D-Star/APRS Handheld Transceivers Kenwood TH-D75A Tri-Band 144/220/430 MHz D-Star/APRS Handheld Transceivers take a significant leap forward with cutting-edge features designed to enhance the user experience for Amateur Radio operators. Building on the success of its predecessor, the TH-D74, this advanced model boasts simultaneous reception of 2 D-STAR signals, Reflector Terminal Mode for accessing D-Star reflectors, enhanced voice guidance, built-in GPS, digipeater functions, as well as an APRS® Standalone Digipeater. Usability has been prioritized in the design of the TH-D75A, incorporating modern conveniences such as a USB Type-C port for serial communications, audio in/out and battery charging. The inclusion of Bluetooth headset PTT support enhances the hands-free operation of the transceiver. Its fully ergonomic design ensures a comfortable and intuitive user experience that caters to the evolving needs of today’s Amateur Radio operators.
